description: This file defines the ReciprocalRankFusion class, a custom document compressor that uses reciprocal rank fusion to re-rank search results based on multiple queries generated by an LLM. It integrates with langchain components for document retrieval and query generation.

classes.name: ReciprocalRankFusion
classes.description: A class that extends BaseDocumentCompressor to implement reciprocal rank fusion for re-ranking documents based on multiple search queries generated by an LLM.

methods.name: compressDocuments
methods.description: Generates multiple queries from the input query using an LLM, retrieves documents for each query, and applies reciprocal rank fusion to re-rank and select top documents.

methods.name: reciprocalRankFunction
methods.description: Calculates reciprocal rank scores for documents, sorts them, and returns the top K documents based on fused scores.
